rows.en: Fores: "Yes. All right, open the channel."
We will now launch an all-out attack on the enemy stronghold.
When this battle ends, you will be heroes.
But that all depends on your actions.
I want you to fulfill your duties as proud soldiers of Zigrim
to the very end. That is all!"
Alforina: "Tyron... I'm sorry... Please take care of..."
Touya: "I understand. I understand, so don't talk anymore..."
Alforina: "...*pant pant*... Our promise... I don't think I can...
Touya: "H-Hey! Isn't there anything we can do?!"
Clovis: "Tch. They mean to wipe us out completely..."
Run and get back to Liebhofen."
We can't just let them get away with this..."
Tyron: "Don't let Her Majesty's... Lady Alforina's death
Arthur: "We have a duty to carry on the queen's will.
It isn't something we can decide on our personal feelings.
Not since the moment we became Spirit Mech Pilots."
Touya: "H-Hey, how can you be so calm...?"
Clovis: "...Stop. The one who's angriest right now...
The one who's grieving most is her."
Touya: "...All right. We'll go back to Liebhofen.
Even if it costs me my life..."
Reamond: "...Lieutenant Colonel. He intends to die here."
If anyone in our army could beat him,
Fores: "All right. I'll assign five of my personal guard mechs to you."
Fores: "I'll be in one of them."
Reamond: "This is my job, after all.
You seem to be in good form today."
Tyron: "There's no need to be so surprised.
I, too, took an interest in that project.
As an opponent of it, of course."
You really are a frightening man."
Tyron: "Flattery won't make me go easy on you."
Reamond: "...But now you've made me get serious..."
Prepare to escape! You there, protect Her Majesty."
Alforina: "I cannot abandon my people and soldiers and flee.
And those people there are not from our country, are they?"
Alforina: "...They seem rather different for that, don't they?"
Oswald: "Th-This is for your sake, Your Majesty.
When I feel so much... for Your Majesty... For my princess..."
Oswald: "Heh heh heh heh... Kah hah hah hah..."
Alforina: "I see... So this is the shadow's true form...
That dream was about you, Lord Exogilm..."
Their target is undoubtedly the queen."
Touya: "Anyway, standing here won't help. Let's go!"
Ymir: "I'm sorry. This craft is so small,
even with just Zeifon and Vishal..."
Arthur: "We don't mind, but more importantly, is Ai
She's desperately trying not to cry."
Arthur: "I see... She and the queen had grown as close
Clovis: "We can leave Ai to Touya.
We've got things we need to do.
It's the least we can do to repay the queen, Tyron and the others."
Yamato: "Hey, Touya. Have you properly apologized to Ai since then?"
That's why I'm looking for Ai, isn't it?"
Touya: "I was only thinking about myself...
You're the one who's really hurting.
Look... Um... I don't know what to say..."
Yamato: "Touya, right now, just leave her..."
Ai: "We were going to make cookies... together, next time...
She was... just an ordinary fourteen-year-old girl..."
Touya: "I don't know how to comfort someone at a time like this...
Touya: "...If you want to cry, you should cry.
It's nothing to be ashamed of.
Touya: "...I... Back then, I wanted to cry..."
Touya: "S-Sorry. That was a strange thing to say...
